# Step - substring

`substring` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Yields the part of each string from start (to end, exclusive); negative positions count from the end.

## Forms

```text
substring(arg1: i64)
substring(arg1: Scope, arg2: i64)
substring(arg1: i64, arg2: i64)
substring(arg1: Scope, arg2: i64, arg3: i64)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").substring(1, 3).next()   // ar
```
